$comment: The words pairtime shows a teen about their time, shared by the coach, the CLI views and the dashboard (DESIGN 3.8; approach-teen.md D5). Plain and kind: credited time is your time, agent-only time is named after the agent, other time is described for what it was, X.noprog seconds that progress can still bring back are on hold, and nothing scolds or counts streaks. {name} is a placeholder; text.go lists which each entry may use.

other.X.ambiguous: in a window pairtime couldn't tie to one project
other.X.autopilot: replies sent before reading the answer
other.X.noprog: past two hours without progress, counted at half
other.X.lookup_cap: looking things up, past what counts

on_hold: on hold: these come back when you fix it

levels.B: pairtime saw you at the computer, not your typing
levels.C: this shows on your own dashboard, not on your profile, build days or most programs

phrases.calibrating_note: Your time shows as calibrating while pairtime checks how it counts.
phrases.level_c_note: {time} of it is level C: it shows on your own dashboard, not on your profile, build days or most programs
phrases.no_session: No work sessions yet. The first one starts when pairtime counts some of your time.
phrases.agent_down: pairtime's agent isn't running, so there's nothing to show yet. Logging in starts it, or run: pairtime agent --detach
phrases.agent_old: The pairtime agent that's running can't show this yet. It can once it restarts on this version.
phrases.agent_slow: pairtime's agent didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.
phrases.agent_error: pairtime couldn't get this from its agent: {error}
phrases.store_error: pairtime couldn't read what its agent stored: {error}
phrases.focus_unknown: Focus unknown on this desktop. Run pairtime doctor to see why.
